recordedProductIssues: The not_visible screen shows the small recorded step card with tiny text

defects.problem: The cross-dissolve from the screenshot to the stat board overlaps the stat text on the screen form, so numbers and labels are illegible in the mid-state.
defects.fix: Shorten the dissolve to a few frames or fade the old screen out first.

defects.problem: Opening shows a small recorded screen with tiny text; the 'No highlight' point is carried only by the headline at feed size.
defects.fix: Tighten the hold to about two frames before the board.

defects.problem: The stat board is static for a long hold, with only the yellow highlight stepping row to row; the sublabels are small at feed size.
defects.fix: Keep the highlight steps, but raise the sublabel size where it fits.

defects.problem: The yellow block on '62.0%' starts partway across the number (wipe artifact) in one frame.
defects.fix: Make the wipe start from the left of the full number box.

couldNotAssess: number-source accuracy beyond the labelled eval/results
oneLineVerdict: The strongest section: big legible numbers, honest framing and calm stability; mostly small nitpicks.
